Cold Clear (cold-clear-wasm-api) - Rust crate licenses

Crates statically linked into the WASM: runtime dependencies for wasm32-unknown-unknown,
excluding proc-macro and build-only crates. Local workspace crates are covered by their own notices.
Upstream Cold Clear has no Cargo.lock; versions were resolved on 2026-10-01 and the list is a superset of what the build links.
The full Apache License 2.0 text is in Apache-2.0.txt in this directory.
